DeleteCustomFieldsDescription: All custom fields and their values will be removed from this item.
DeleteFieldsDescription: The removed fields will be deleted together with their values in all files, folders and rooms. This action cannot be undone.
DeleteTemplateDescription: The template will no longer be available for assignment, and its values will be removed from all files, folders and rooms.
DeleteTemplateMetadataDescription: The template and its field values will be removed from this item.
FieldNameExists: A field with this name already exists
FieldsDescription: Fields are what users fill in when this template is applied to a file, folder or room. Drag to reorder — users will see the fields in this order.
HiddenTemplateHint: Hidden templates can be assigned via API only and are not shown in template pickers.
MetadataTemplatesDescription: Create and manage metadata templates — named sets of typed fields (Text, Number, Date, Single and Multi select) assigned to files, folders and rooms. Field values power list filtering, global search and AI autofill.
NoFileMetadata: No metadata on this file yet
NoFileMetadataDescription: Add a template to describe this file with structured fields
NoFolderMetadata: No metadata on this folder yet
NoFolderMetadataDescription: Add a template to describe this folder with structured fields
NoRoomMetadata: No metadata on this room yet
NoRoomMetadataDescription: Add a template to describe this room with structured fields
NoTemplatesToAddDescription: All available templates have already been added, or none have been created yet. Administrators create templates in the portal settings.
NotFoundTemplatesDescription: No templates match your search. Try a different name or clear the search field to see all templates.
